name: Alustriel’s Mooncloak

source.note: Compared with the published D&D Beyond chapter on 2026-10-06: https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/frhof/magic-of-faerun.  Artificer is omitted where listed because that class is not available in this game.

summary: Moonlight fills a 20-foot Emanation around you. You and your allies in it have Half Cover and Resistance to Cold, Lightning and Radiant damage. You can end the spell early: as a Reaction when you fail a save against being Frightened, Grappled or Restrained, to succeed instead (in a fight, set it to Automatic in the class tab), or as a Magic action to heal yourself or an ally in the moonlight for 4d10 + your spellcasting modifier.
